electro-drift.desc_en: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

collision-course.desc_en: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

psystrike.desc_es: Crea una onda psíquica que causa daño físico al objetivo.
psystrike.desc_en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

dragon-ascent.desc_es: El usuario se precipita desde el cielo a una velocidad de vértigo para atacar al objetivo, pero hace que bajen la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del usuario.
dragon-ascent.desc_en: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds, although it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def in the process.

origin-pulse.desc_es: Ataca al objetivo con una infinidad de rayos de luz azulada.
origin-pulse.desc_en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

precipice-blades.desc_es: Hace que el poder latente de la tierra se manifieste en forma de hojas afiladas y ataca al objetivo con ellas.
precipice-blades.desc_en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

judgment.desc_es: Emite incontables haces de luz. Varía según el tipo de tabla que lleve el usuario.
judgment.desc_en: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

aeroblast.desc_es: Lanza un chorro de aire que suele dar un golpe crítico.
aeroblast.desc_en: Has a high criti­ cal hit ratio.

sacred-fire.desc_es: Fuego místico de gran intensidad que puede causar quemaduras.
sacred-fire.desc_en: An attack that may inflict a burn.

roar-of-time.desc_es: Ataca al objetivo usando tal energía que el tiempo se distorsiona. El usuario descansa el siguiente turno.
roar-of-time.desc_en: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

spacial-rend.desc_es: Desgarra al objetivo y el espacio a su alrededor. Suele ser crítico.
spacial-rend.desc_en: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

shadow-force.desc_es: En el primer turno, desaparece. En el segundo, golpea al objetivo aunque se esté protegiendo.
shadow-force.desc_en: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.
